args.body: Claim CATALOGUE-EDITOR-RESOURCE-PLACEMENT. Start with prior distribution evidence and direct publisher submission rules. On a verified fit, prepare the actual operator submission using the live catalogue URL and saved independent rehearsal. Stop after the bounded publisher checks if neither invites an eligible resource. Keep item 4 and the consolidated site release separate.

description: Commercial feedback is available but incomplete. It shows zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury reports no verified funds or settled revenue. The catalogue offer has a reproducible example, and the existing release mission owns its public placement. This turn will test a separate distribution route through a publisher that explicitly accepts outside resources. The operator’s existing send-or-decline decision and the host’s independent review gate still apply.
